text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After the Representative Exchange Race, 
Satono Diamond declines representing 
Japan. Having raced with all her might, 
she accepted her current shortcomings.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though frustration lingers in her eyes, 
her gaze is fixed firmly ahead. She says 
she will offer full support for the sake 
of her own growth as well.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
<chrname> was selected as Japan's representative. 
Satono Diamond also raised her hand, 
wishing to accompany the overseas 
expedition.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not giving up, but making a choice for the 
future— Embracing Satono Diamond's strong 
feelings, they set their sights on victory 
in the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...!
